Appearance:
MR NITIN M AMIN(126) for the Applicant(s) No. 1,2,3,4,5 MR RD DAVE(264) for the Respondent(s) No. 1 MS KRINA P. CALLA, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 2 ======================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE UMESH A. TRIVEDI  Date : 15/09/2023  ORAL ORDER 1. This petition is filed by the applicants - original accused, who are facing charge under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506(2) and 114 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, as also under Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, pursuant to an FIR filed by respondent No. 1 herein, which culminated into Criminal Case No. 247 of 2022 pending in the Court of 6 th Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Jamnagar.

2.1 He has further submitted that since the matter is settled between the husband and wife, an agreement is also executed between them.
2.2 Pursuant thereto, divorce decree has also come to be passed by the competent Court.
A proceedings initiated under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005, is also withdrawn by the respondent No. 1 herein.

entities.text: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. Respondent No. 1 herein has also filed the affidavit in this very proceeding, which is at page 31,
though she is not present personally before the Court, Mr. Rajesh D. Dave, learned advocate for the respondent No. 1, submits that it being a matrimonial dispute between the husband and wife and it has already been resolved, her presence may not be insisted as other proceedings are already terminated.
4. As coming out from the affidavit, matter is settled between the parties and they have acted upon the agreement entered into between them.

Pursuant thereto, two other proceedings are already over between the parties, and they request for quashing of this criminal case filed at the instance of the respondent No. 1 herein, as keeping the case pending would add to the agony of the parties and no fruitful purpose NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/16807/2022 ORDER DATED: 15/09/2023 undefined
would be served keeping it pending as matter is already settled between them.

5. As such when the matrimonial dispute is settled between the parties, it would be in the interest of both of them to quash the present proceedings also, more particularly when, decree of divorce between the husband and wife is also passed, severing the matrimonial ties.
6. Even Supreme Court has also encouraged such settlements in between the parties in matrimonial dispute in several cases.

Considering the same, the Criminal Case No. 247 of 2022 pending in the Court of 6th Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Jamnagar filed at the instance of respondent No. 1 herein is hereby quashed and set aside.

sentences.text: Rule made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Direct service is permitted.
